name: What is a drain camera inspection?

mainEntity.name: What is a drain camera inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A drain camera inspection involves using a small, waterproof camera attached to a flexible rod to visually inspect the interior of your plumbing lines. The camera transmits live video to a monitor, allowing a technician to identify problems such as blockages, cracks, root intrusion, or pipe corrosion without disruptive digging. This method provides a clear, real-time view of your drain system's condition, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A drain camera inspection uses a small camera to visually inspect the inside of your pipes, identifying issues like blockages or damage without excavation.
